findings.summary: The route trusts the cart tenant instead of scoping lookup to the authenticated tenant, enabling cross-tenant checkout.
The external payment charge occurs inside a retryable database transaction and can execute more than once.
Rollback failure is swallowed, hiding an unknown transaction state.
The replacement log drops request/order/tenant correlation fields needed to diagnose checkout failures.

redHerrings.summary: Use a destructuring assignment for cart fields
